_NAMING: The 'v2' in this filename is the SOURCE PACK version. There is now also a PROMPT SET v2 (prompts/expanded.v2.jsonl) — a different axis entirely. Everything in this file was measured against prompt set v1 (prompts/expanded.jsonl) over source pack v2. Prompt set v2 revised the 10 document:spreadsheet-text prompts, so its 10 new digests have no traces here and its floor is recorded separately in noise_floor.promptset-v2.ai19-ollama.json. Do not read the two as versions of one series.
_note: Repeat groups arise because 260 families share 78 prompts; each group is independent calls at identical settings, so it measures runtime variance.
_LIMITATION_within_run_only: These 49 groups are repeats WITHIN a single generation pass. The v1 floor was measured ACROSS separate runs (r0/r1/r2). They are not directly comparable: within-run repeats share session and batching conditions, and the v1 evidence showed variance is bimodal with mode selection plausibly tied to batching. A within-run floor can therefore understate across-run variance.
_across_run_v2_evidence: Superseded by across_run below, which measures the full expanded set instead of the 3 volatile families. Retained for history: prose:cekAman::0001 and prose:tanyaDokumen::0001 were stable across 3 runs; prose:umum::0000 showed 2 modes.

across_run._traces_are_gitignored: Both files are excluded by .gitignore (*.jsonl). The digests above, plus data/<pass>/MANIFEST.json, are the committed record of which bytes this measurement read. Regenerating a pass produces different bytes and a different digest — that invalidates this result rather than reproducing it.
across_run._plan_consistency: All 9 pinned fields identical across passes (split_fingerprint ccb5ff683228c4c9, template_sha256 114f55eb…, muse-glimmer:30b, int4_ollama, ai19-ollama, reasoning high, temperature 0.0, seed 0). The two passes are two observations of one configuration.

mode_frequency_drift._correction: Supersedes the earlier characterisation of across-run text variance as 2/78. That figure counted only prompts where a mode APPEARED or VANISHED. Nine further prompts kept an identical mode set while the mixture moved — 4:1 in one pass against 1:4 in the other reads as 'same set' to a membership test. Measured on the same bytes; no regeneration was involved in this correction.
mode_frequency_drift._why_it_matters: The mixture is what a training corpus inherits. Metric means were unmoved (all deltas 0.0) because the competing modes are equally acceptable answers, so this is not a quality finding — but 14.1% of prompts having an unstable answer mixture is the honest figure for run-to-run textual stability, not 2.6%.

_rescored_at_wider_coverage._what: The floor above was FIRST measured when only the 8 router strata carried checks (constraints_ok 24/78, source_preserved 0/78). src/author_checks.py then derived checks for 13 further strata, taking coverage to 21/26. Both passes were RE-SCORED, not regenerated: checks are scoring metadata and are not rendered into the prompt, so all 520 traces still hash to the prompt_sha256 recorded at generation time (verified, 0 mismatches).
_rescored_at_wider_coverage.result: Every across-pass delta remained 0.0 at the wider coverage. The floor now rests on twice the constraint evidence and on figure-preservation evidence that did not exist before.
_two_scorer_defects_found_by_doing_this: calibrate.bullets() counted a Markdown bold heading ('**Ringkasan**') as a bullet, because the pattern accepted a bare leading asterisk. A compliant 5-bullet slide scored as 6 and failed max_bullets=5, which presented as a model failure (constraints_ok 0.98) that did not exist. Fixed: a marker must be followed by whitespace, and '**' is excluded. Re-checked the committed int4 calibration baseline under both counters — constraint_satisfaction is 0.9706 either way, so no recorded result needed revision.

The first spreadsheet check demanded all 16 cell values and the 75,0 threshold, scoring the stratum at 0.264. The completions were correct: the instruction asks only for status and owner, which they gave in full. An over-broad check reads exactly like a model failure. Narrowed to row labels, statuses and owner.
_rescored_at_wider_coverage._still_unmeasured: Table-value fidelity. Checking that cell values survive requires a prompt that asks for the table back; this stratum's prompt asks for status and owner. That is a new prompt, therefore a new generation — not a check that can be attached to the traces on disk.

across_run._finding: The across-run METRIC floor is 0.0, same as the within-run floor — so the within-run measurement did not understate the metric floor after all. Answer TEXT is not equally stable. Two figures, and the larger one is the right one to quote: 2 of 78 prompts (2.6%) gained or lost a mode outright, and 11 of 78 (14.1%) had their mode MIXTURE move, the other 9 having kept an identical mode set at different frequencies. See mode_frequency_drift. Textual variance across runs is real and non-trivial; it simply did not move any metric, because the competing modes are equally acceptable answers.

_mode_shift_groups.shape: 1 mode in A, 2 in B — B added a variant that answers the question in the negative ('the memo does not state implementation provisions')
2 modes in A, 1 in B — the mode missing from B preserved the source figures (346 bit, 5 jam) correctly; both modes are plausible edits

across_run._LIMITATION_coverage: Still not a whole-corpus statement, though the gap is much smaller. 21 of 26 strata now carry a check; 5 remain without one (prose:cekAman, prose:draftTeks, prose:tanyaDokumen, prose:ubahNada, prose:umum). Those are open-ended — explain, draft, re-register, assess — and entail no countable structure or figure that must survive, so they are deliberately left empty rather than given an invented constraint. They contribute to the answer-agreement counts and to refusal/empty/truncated/indonesian, but to neither constraints_ok nor source_preserved. Note also that both mode-shift groups (document:memo, edit:ubah_istilah) now DO sit in checked strata, and their metrics agreed across passes — the differing text was two acceptable answers, not one right and one wrong.
across_run._use: Usable as the across-run floor for the 21 checked strata, which is most of the corpus but not all of it. Standing constraints: (1) do NOT cite this 0.0 as unqualified corpus-wide reproducibility — 5 prose strata still contribute to no constraint or preservation metric, and table-value fidelity is unmeasured everywhere; (2) the bar on promoting this corpus to training was set while 18 strata were unchecked. It is now 5. Whether that clears the bar is a judgement for the corpus owner, not something this file should assert on its own — the measurement is here, the decision is not.

_next: DONE — the edit strata now carry preserve lists, and 'Pertahankan angka persis seperti sumber' is verified rather than merely instructed. Coverage went 8/26 -> 21/26 via src/author_checks.py, and the floor was re-measured on the same bytes.

Table-value fidelity is unmeasured. document:spreadsheet-text asks only for status and owner, so no check on this prompt can test whether cell values survive. Needs a prompt that asks for the table back — a new prompt, hence a new generation.

5 open-ended prose strata (cekAman, draftTeks, tanyaDokumen, ubahNada, umum) remain uncheckable by mechanical means. If they need coverage, it is blind pairwise review, not another derived check — calibrate.py's own docstring reserves anything subjective for exactly that.

The 2/78 across-run text shift is characterised but not explained. Both groups sit in checked strata and both passes scored equally, so it is answer-selection variance under identical settings, plausibly batching-related as the v1 evidence suggested. Not blocking; worth knowing before anyone reads a small metric delta in a future run as signal.
